title: AutoFeatureTour login (platforms/<name>/login.json)
description: How to sign in, per role. Credentials only as "{env:NAME}" (environment or .env). Saved state: auth/<platform>/<env>/<role>.json.

$schema.description: This file's schema, for editors: a relative path to schemas/<type>.schema.json, or its $id URL (https://autofeaturetour.local/schemas/v1/<type>.schema.json). `aft schema <type> --write <folder>` puts a copy beside a file kept outside the checkout. The loader ignores it.

default.description: Role used when none is given.

signedIn.description: CSS of an element only a signed-in page shows; how an expired session is noticed.

checkPath.description: Path opened to check the session (default startPath).

maxAgeMinutes.description: Sign in again when the saved state is older than this.
